verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Funnels report that measures conversion through a series of events, and its marketing describes finding critical drop-off points, so the core multi-step funnel exists. Filtering is documented only generically through properties, and breakdowns only for events in the Query API, not within funnels. missing for 10: explicit documentation of filters and breakdowns inside the Funnels report, step-level drop-off visualization details, independent hands-on corroboration of funnel breakdowns.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off

citations.quote: Measure conversions through a series of events
Discover critical drop-off points and calibrate user journeys
Properties allow you to create groups of users (aka cohorts) and also enable you to filter for certain events or users.
